requirements.text: Students should be able to check the availability of books and materials.
Students should be able to borrow and return items online without needing to come to the desk.
Students should be able to view their current loans and any fines they have.
The system should send email reminders a few days before due dates.
Staff should have a way to manage inventory easily, including adding, updating, or retiring items from the catalog.
The system should generate reports on what’s being borrowed and what’s popular.
The system must preserve the personal service aspect at the desk, particularly for managing loans and fines.
The new system should integrate well with existing processes and systems.
